name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 37 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2025-06-30, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.81 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
